title: Island Frequency
style: Pacific island pop, 108 BPM, ukulele rhythm bed, soft percussion, warm tropical energy, Filipino-leaning Pacific feel, gentle breeze vibe, male vocal warm and smooth, bilingual hook English and Tagalog, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Island frequency — different time
Pacific morning — different rhyme
Tagalog greeting — Maayong Umaga
Island signal — MOSOKO saga

[CHORUS]
Island frequency — find me here
Island frequency — crystal clear
Island frequency — Pacific call
Island frequency — MOSOKO for all

[VERSE 2]
From Manila to Cebu — learning daily
Ilocano, Bisaya — speaking freely
The lesson comes in the language you feel

[BRIDGE — Tagalog]
Walang hadlang sa pagkatuto
No barrier to learning today
Ang musika ay wika rin natin
Music is also our language

[FINAL CHORUS]
Island frequency — tuned in
Island frequency — begin
Island frequency — Pacific rising
Island frequency — MOSOKO shining

[OUTRO]
Island.
Frequency.
Always on.
